tagline: Outwardly humble and deferential as befits his station, yet possesses a calculating mind constantly
bio: Maria Dolfin, once a humble facchina at Venice's bustling public docks, has risen through diligent labor and shrewd investments to become a respected figure in the city's maritime commerce. Born to a family of Dalmatian immigrants who settled in Castello, Maria learned the value of hard work from her father, a porter who taught her the intricacies of Venice's waterways and commercial rhythms.
